Because the work item was still marked DONE despite not meeting its stated purpose, and the critical verification obligation on this question (VOB-U-ACTUAL-READ-DISPUTE-CAUSE) remains OPEN, the release decision is HOLD: no agent action, fix, or new finding is released.
